decisions.reason: The clarification changes the connector-inventory pin-count scope but does not alter the panel connector coverage, GPIO mappings, mounting, or connection mode.
The existing 4-pin charge-status connector specification remains unchanged; the source provides no replacement pin count or charge-output change.
Connector pin-count scope does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment or assignment policy.
The battery connector already has a concrete 3-pin specification, and the source does not change its pin count, pin functions, family, or placement.
The connector pin-count clarification has no effect on the main-board decoupling requirement.
The source concerns connector pin-count scope and does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, or current-coverage behavior.
The source explicitly excludes interboard connectors from the low-pin-count scope, so the existing interboard connector types and pinouts remain unchanged.
The clarification does not change LED supply voltage, power switching, or logic-level shifting.
Connector pin-count scope does not affect the OR-ing method, power sources, diode requirement, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, powered scope, or programming support.
The low-pin-count clarification is unrelated to I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The source does not change board dimensions, enclosure fit, mounting holes, connector placement, or mechanical clearances.
